summary: All three targets (eps 61-63, S4E2-4) promoted to exact records with high confidence. The anime splits chapters 93-98 by timeline, not by chapter: ep 61 takes ch 93 plus the PRESENT-DAY halves of 94-95 (arrival/dinner/HQ festival briefing), ep 62 takes the FLASHBACK halves of 94-95 plus ch 96 and essentially all of ch 97 (through 97's final scene, Falco meeting 'Kruger' at the hospital), ep 63 opens on leftover 97/95 slivers then adapts ch 98 in full. Episode-side fandom infoboxes, the chapter-side reverse map (chs 92-98 walked individually), animefillerguide, and per-episode reviews (Review Monster, Hana's Blog, doublesama) all agree exactly. One zone fact was wrong: ch 92 belongs entirely to ep 60 (fandom ep-60 infobox + AFG '60: 91, 92'), so the 61-63 rearranged zone is chs 93-98, not 92-98. Ep 64's stored anchor (end 100, start 99) is confirmed by AFG's '64: 99, 100' — no repairs anywhere; nothing outside 61-63 touched.

anchors.chapters_adapted: 93, 94 (present-day part: Liberio arrival, family reunions, Braun dinner), 95 (present-day part: internment-zone walk, Zeke's HQ briefing on the festival/Tybur plan)
anchors.note: Ch 93 in full, then only the present-day framing scenes of 94-95; Reiner's flashback halves of 94-95 are deferred to ep 62. Fandom infobox (93/94/95), chapter reverse map, AFG '61: 93, 94, 95', Review Monster ('starts adapting 93... then a merged adaptation of parts of 94 and 95, skipping Reiner's flashback').

anchors.chapters_adapted: 94 (flashback part: Reiner's childhood, Warrior-candidate years), 95 (flashback part: selection, parade, father, journey to the Wall, Marcel's death), 96, 97 (Annie/104th flashbacks, present-day suicide-attempt frame, Falco meets 'Kruger' — through ch 97's final scene)
anchors.note: Non-monotonic vs ep 61 (starts back at 94) — honest reorder values. Ep 62 reaches ch 97's last scene (hospital talk), so the reader's resume is 98 = end+1. Fandom infobox lists 94/95/96/97; AFG '62: 94, 95, 96, 97'; Hana's Blog review confirms 95-97 material with 96 partially trimmed (Wall Maria assault sequence cut).

anchors.chapters_adapted: 97 (leftover sliver: Falco's letter-errand frame for Kruger), 95 (fragment: Warrior HQ discussion beats, likely relocated from ch 95's meeting), 98
anchors.note: Bulk of the episode is ch 98 in full (military meeting, Falco beats Gabi, festival stage, Magath-Willy, Falco/Kruger + 'Dr. Yeager' at the hospital); opens on 97/95 slivers, so start = first full chapter 98 per majority rule (AFG in-episode order '97, 95, 98'; fandom infobox Liar/97/Good to See). Continue = 99 = end+1, matching stored ep 64 (start 99).

continue_points.note: Ep 61 adapts only the present-day halves of 94-95; the reader resumes at ch 94 to get Reiner's flashback (differs from end+1 = 96).

annotation_updates.note: Zone chapter set corrected from 92-98 to 93-98: ch 92 (Marley's Soldiers) is adapted entirely by ep 60 per its fandom infobox (91+92) and AFG ('60: 91, 92'). The interleave is timeline-based: present-day halves of 94-95 in ep 61, flashback halves of 94-95 + 96-97 in ep 62, 97/95 slivers + 98 in ep 63; per-episode exact records now exist for all three.
